name: Netflix
summary: Review active devices, use a unique password, and manage your viewing history.

settings.name: Sign Out of Unrecognized Devices
clickPath: Sign out of devices you don't recognize
settings.impact: Your credentials may still be saved on ex-partners', family members', or previously shared devices. Unauthorized access can also indicate account compromise.
settings.source: Netflix Help Center: 'How to Keep Your Account Secure'

settings.name: Account Password
settings.impact: Netflix accounts are targeted in credential-stuffing attacks using passwords leaked from other services. A unique strong password prevents this attack. Use a password manager.
settings.source: Netflix Help Center Account Security documentation

settings.name: Viewing Activity Privacy
clickPath: Hide icon next to specific titles
settings.impact: Netflix viewing history can reveal sensitive interests and is visible to other profile users on the same account. Hiding specific titles removes them from shared view.

settings.name: Email Account Verification
clickPath: Verify Email Address is current and accessible
settings.impact: Netflix sends notifications for new device sign-ins and account changes to your registered email. An outdated email means you will not receive security alerts.
settings.source: Netflix Help Center: 'How to Keep Your Account Secure'

settings.name: Phone Number for Verification
settings.impact: Netflix uses your phone number for risky-login verification, sending a code when it detects unusual sign-in patterns. Without it, account recovery is significantly harder.
